newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Steniel sells property for 220 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Steniel sells property for 220 mln pesos.

text.p: Packaging firm Steniel Manufacturing Corp said on Monday it has sold its three-hectare property in Rizal province, east of Manila, for 220 million pesos.
The firm said in a statement the proceeds from the sale of the property will be used to reduce its debt and provide working capital for its corrugated carton business.
"The sale will not generate any gain or loss as this forms part of the overall reorganisation programme," it said.

The property housed Steniel's original corrugated carton plant which was closed down in late 1996 after the firm integrated its carton manufacturing operations in Luzon island by building a more modern plant in Cavite near Manila.
Steniel said it planned to build another plant in southern Davao city.
President Augie Palisoc said the sale of Steniel's Cainta property would reduce the company's debt to a more manageable level.
Steniel is a unit of Metro Pacific Corp.
